summary_en: Daidoh Steel completed tender offer for 1,753,204 Tohoku Steel shares (23.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) at undisclosed price. Tender period ended 29 June 2026. Settlement begins 6 July 2026. Upon settlement, Daidoh Steel's voting stake exceeds 50%, elevating it from affiliate to parent company.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Public Tender Offer for Company Shares by Daidoh Steel Co., Ltd. (Related Company) and Notice of Changes in Parent Company and Other Related Companies
translation_en_brief:
Daidoh Steel Co., Ltd. (Daidoh) completed a public tender offer for ordinary shares of Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. that ran from 18 May 2026 through 29 June 2026. The tender succeeded: 1,753,204 shares were tendered and will be acquired in full. The disclosed ex-treasury share count is 7,427,759 shares, making the acquisition 23.6% of shares outstanding.

Settlement of the acquisition commences 6 July 2026. Upon settlement, Daidoh's aggregate voting stake will exceed 50%, triggering a reclassification: Daidoh will become Tohoku Steel's parent company, upgraded from its prior status as a related company. Prior to the offer, Daidoh held 2,549,500 shares (34.32% of the ex-treasury base). The filing does not disclose the tender price or total yen consideration.
